Build H3 hierarchy maps for multiscale planning units

build_h3_maps.Rd

Creates parent–child relationships among H3 planning units represented at multiple resolutions.

Usage

build_h3_maps(s_or_h3, res_vec = NULL, res_levels = NULL)

Arguments

s_or_h3

An sf object or data frame containing h3_address and res columns, or a character vector of H3 indexes.

res_vec

Optional integer vector of H3 resolutions. Required when s_or_h3 is supplied as a character vector.

res_levels

Optional integer vector of resolutions represented in the hierarchy. Defaults to the unique resolutions in the planning units.

Value

A list with elements h3_vec, res_vec, res_levels, row_idx_by_h3, nearest_parent_row_of, and children_by_row.

Details

The supplied res or res_vec values are used directly and should match the resolutions encoded by the corresponding H3 indexes.

Examples

# Minimal example: two resolutions, parent-child relationship
h3_child  <- "8a2a1072b59ffff" # example H3 index
h3_parent <- "892a1072b5bffff"

h3_vec <- c(h3_parent, h3_child)
h3_res <- h3jsr::get_res(h3_vec, simple = TRUE)

maps <- build_h3_maps(s_or_h3 = h3_vec, res_vec = h3_res)

str(maps, max.level = 1)
#> List of 6
#>  $ h3_vec               : chr [1:2] "892a1072b5bffff" "8a2a1072b59ffff"
#>  $ res_vec              : int [1:2] 9 10
#>  $ res_levels           : int [1:2] 9 10
#>  $ row_idx_by_h3        : Named int [1:2] 1 2
#>   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:2] "892a1072b5bffff" "8a2a1072b59ffff"
#>  $ nearest_parent_row_of: int [1:2] NA 1
#>  $ children_by_row      :List of 2
maps$nearest_parent_row_of
#> [1] NA  1
